title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation ~Eris Sharpens Her Fangs~
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A one-volume spin-off of Jobless Reincarnation. After a crushing defeat by the Dragon God Orsted, in which she could not protect Rudeus, the former noble girl Eris Boreas Greyrat leaves him and travels to the Sword Sanctum to train under the Sword God, determined to become strong enough to support him.
life_message: Real devotion means becoming strong enough to stand beside the person you love.
